content.title: Baumgardner vs Shin - News, Tape, Ringwalk, TV, Streaming & Tickets
content.text: Who won Baumgardner vs Shin? Alycia Baumgardner beat Bo Mi Re Shin by unanimous decision in their 10 round contest on Friday, April 17th, 2026, at Madison Square Garden Theater, New York. The scorecards were announced as 98-92, 98-92, 99-91 in favor of winner Alycia Baumgardner. The fight was scheduled to take place over 10 rounds in the Super Featherweight division, which meant the weight limit was 130 pounds (9.3 stone or 59 kg). The undercard featured the clash of Green vs Daniels. Baumgardner vs Shin stats Alycia Baumgardner stepped into the ring with a record of 17 wins, 1 loss, and 0 draws, 7 of those wins coming by way of knockout. Bo Mi Re Shin made her way to the ring with a record of 19 wins, 3 losses and 3 draws, with 10 of those wins by knockout. The stats suggested Shin had an advantage in power over Baumgardner, with a 53% knockout percentage compared to Baumgardner's 41%. Alycia Baumgardner was the younger woman by 1 year, at 31 years old. Both Alycia Baumgardner and Bo Mi Re Shin fought out of an orthodox stance. Baumgardner was the less experienced professional fighter, having had 7 fewer fights, and made her debut in 2017, 11 months later than Shin, whose first professional fight was in 2016. She had fought 41 fewer professional rounds, totaling 122 compared to Shin's 163. Baumgardner vs Shin form Alycia Baumgardner had beaten 4 of her last 5 opponents. In her last fight before this contest, she had defeated Leila Beaudoin on December 19, 2025, by unanimous decision in their 12 round contest at Kaseya Center, Miami, United States. Prior to that, she had defeated Jennifer Miranda on July 11, 2025, by unanimous decision in their 10 round contest at Madison Square Garden, New York. Going into that contest, she had defeated Delfine Persoon on September 27, 2024, by unanimous decision in the 4th round at Lux Stage @ Trilith Studios, Atlanta. Before that, she had beaten Christina Linardatou on July 15, 2023, by unanimous decision in their 10 round contest at Masonic Temple, Detroit. She had won against Elhem Mekhaled on February 4, 2023, by unanimous decision in their 10 round contest at Madison Square Garden Theater, New York. Activity check Baumgardner's last 5 fights had come over a period of 3 years, 2 months and 13 days, which means she had been fighting approximately every 7 months and 21 days. In those fights, she fought a total of 46 rounds, meaning that they had lasted 9.2 rounds on average. What time did Baumgardner vs Shin start? The fighters were expected to ringwalk at around 11:00 PM EST / 8:00 PM PST at Madison Square Garden Theater, New York, United States, which was around 4:00 AM BST in the UK. Who broadcast Baumgardner vs Shin? The ESPN show began at 10:00 PM EST / 7:00 PM PST. The Sky Sports+ broadcast of the card started at 2:00 AM (BST). What were the odds on Baumgardner vs Shin? Alycia Baumgardner was a 1/16 (-1700) favorite going into the contest, while Bo Mi Re Shin made her way into the ring at 21/2 (+1200) with oddsmakers.
